sam: Heads-up — trying to onboard model zeta-7b-int8 and CI failed fast with serve-lint + runtime kernel mismatch.

sam: CI log snippet:
```
ERROR: tokenizer not found at /mnt/models/zeta-7b/vocab.json
ERROR: kernel selection failed: no compatible int8 kernel for CUDA 11.8 + triton 21.12
serve-lint: config validation failed: quantization: 'int8_static' requires calibration table
```

lara: ugh. which CI image are we using for that job?

sam: image: redwood/serve:ci-2024-11-cuda11.8-triton-21.12. Job is model-onboard/zeta-7b-int8.

dev-bot: <https://ci.redwood.com/job/12345|job/12345> failed (serve-lint). Tests: tokenizer, config-lint, runtime-integ.

aj: quick q — do we actually support int8 kernels on CUDA 11.8 for this model family? my recollection: our int8 AVX kernels require newer cuBLASLt shipped with CUDA12+.

sam: yeah i think that's the mismatch. The model weights use per-channel quant artifacts that need the newer kernel path. Runtime tried to select 'fast-int8' but couldn't find a compatible shared object.

maggie: can we fallback to fp16 for now so onboarding can proceed? We can flag quantized build as blocked until infra patch.

chen: also the tokenizer path: the model archive has "Vocab.json" (capital V) not "vocab.json" — serve-lint is case-sensitive because containers are linux but some exporter wrote uppercase. Easy fix in manifest or a symlink.

lara: propose immediate plan:
- patch serve-lint to emit clearer hint about tokenizer filename case (chen can do)
- temp onboarding: change model serving config to quantization: fp16 and set kernel_fallback: generic-llm
- infra: rebuild ci image with CUDA12.x + triton 23.x (aj + eng-infra)
- longer: add int8 kernel bundle for legacy CUDA11 images if possible (runtime research)

sam: i can submit the temp onboarding PR to model-registry with fp16 + symlink updates. will link.

chen: I'll open a tiny PR to normalize file names on exporters and update serve-lint message.

aj: i'll schedule a container rebuild. ETA ~ tomorrow EOD. Will open a pipeline: "ci-rebuild/cuda12-triton23" and add a canary tag. Need owners from eng-runtime to test.

maggie: i'll take runtime test validation (latency + correctness) once canary image is ready. ping me in the PR.

sam: PR: <https://git.redwood/model-registry/pull/789|model-registry#789> — changes: set quantization: fp16, add /mnt/models/zeta-7b/vocab.json -> Vocab.json symlink, config:kernal_fallback: generic-llm.

lara: thanks. aj — can you also document the specific kernel error so SRE knows what to look for in logs during the rebuild? maybe a one-liner to grep?

aj: yes: grep for "no compatible int8 kernel" in /var/log/serve/runtime.log and check for 'cuBLASLt not found' stack traces. I'll add that to the pipeline notes.

dev-bot: CI job retriggered for PR#789 — job/12347 queued.

sam: quick local repro (if you want to debug before rebuild):
```bash
docker run --rm -v /local/models:/mnt/models redwood/serve:ci-2024-11-cuda11.8-triton-21.12 \
  ./serve --model /mnt/models/zeta-7b --validate-config
```
That reproduces serve-lint + kernel select failure for me.

chen: noted — i'll add a lowercase rename step to exporter to avoid repeated pain.

maggie: marking onboarding as blocked->workaround in the tracker. I'll re-run perf once the canary image is up and PR merged.

lara: sweet. thanks everyone. if anything blocks the rebuild mention @eng-infra and @eng-runtime. :thumbsup:

sam: will follow up after job/12347 completes. cc @maggie for validation.
